note: Exact pinned build inputs. Verify with: pixi install && tools/build --check-toolchain. The pixi.lock file carries authoritative conda package hashes; this file records the selected versions and their provenance.

libbpf_source.note: System provides libbpf.so.1 runtime but no headers; build from this pinned source.

host_cc.role: host C compilation fallback; native builds use clang

libelf.note: Build input for the libbpf source build. Headers verified installable via apt on Ubuntu 26.04; the native build step verifies with pkg-config and fails closed when they are absent.

linux_headers.role: UAPI headers (<linux/bpf.h>) for the bridge and fixtures
linux_headers.note: Backward-stable kernel UAPI; pinned for exact reproduction.

python.role: development validation only; never runtime collection

platform_floor.kernel: >= 7.0 for collection; passive inspection and offline work have no kernel floor
platform_floor.note: A version string is eligibility only. Each capability needs its own profile and live evidence.

decisions: D1: pixi (pixi.toml + pixi.lock) is the Mojo project manifest; one manifest per repository.
D2: Mojo 1.1.0 stable from the public max channel; nightly builds are not used.
D3: libbpf is built from the pinned v1.7.0 source tarball with hash check; no system-header dependency.
D4: System clang 21.1.8 pinned by exact version string; its BPF backend is mature and this avoids a large conda toolchain. Revisit on BPF codegen issues.
D5: CMake + Ninja is the native build driver, invoked only through tools/build (single supported path).
D6: Validation tooling uses Python standard library only; no third-party Python dependencies.
